steps.code:
# Parse each file and reorganize
import os

base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_files/'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files')

for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
        ext = '.' + ext
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # Create destination directory: base_dir + file_name + '/'
    dest_dir = base_dir + file_name + '/'
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dest_dir, recursive=True)
    # Destination file path: dest_dir + date_part + ext
    dest_file = dest_dir + date_part + ext
    # Move file
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_file)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_file}")
